# Code Anchors: Feature Issue Migration

- `libs/portable-tools/src/feature-migrate.ts` — plans and applies the migration: folder lookup, feature placement, body edits and read-back.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/feature-issue-cli.ts` — the `nexus feature-issue migrate [--apply]` verb and its opt-in refusal.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/feature-link.ts` — the guarded body write of the feature reference and the shared related link.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/serialize.ts` — serializes the hidden block the read-back check compares against.
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/close-stubs.ts` — passes the epic's feature issue to every stub close files.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — declares the retired-feature label setting and its default.
